root_cause.text: The fence reference obtained from amdgpu_ib_schedule() was released via dma_fence_put() before calling dma_fence_wait(), creating a use-after-free if the put drops the last reference and frees the fence object.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "the code drops the fence reference using dma_fence_put() before calling dma_fence_wait(). If dma_fence_put() releases the last reference, the fence may be freed before dma_fence_wait() is called. This can lead to a use-after-free." The patch diff shows the reversal of the two calls: moving dma_fence_put(f) after dma_fence_wait(f, false).
